record_format_notes.files: Key by installed relative path; include operation, ownership, source_commit, upstream_sha256, installed_sha256, and status. Record a reason for unknown hashes. For a conflict retain the actual installed revision and separately identify the pending one.
record_format_notes.managed_blocks: Key by containing relative file; include begin/end markers, source_commit, upstream_sha256, installed_sha256, and status. Hash block text separately from the outside instructions.
record_format_notes.project_integrations: Record config/context/ignore/template edits as project-owned; never use their full-file hashes as permission to overwrite project settings.
record_format_notes.example: This is a format example with no real installation evidence. Fill fields from observed source and installed content; do not copy this file directly as a completed lock.
